title: Launch runbook: SDK + API surface (function-calling, structured output, streaming) — docs & samples handoff
creator: Anika Rao
description: Goal: Coordinate cross-team launch activities for the SDK and API surface additions that enable first-class function calling, structured output schemas, and streaming across supported SDKs (python, js, go). Deliverables: launch runbook, finalized release notes, canonical docs, 3 sample apps (chat + tool-calling, structured invoice parser, streaming-transcribe example), and CI smoke tests. This ticket centralizes orchestration tasks, assigns owners for each deliverable, records trade-offs, and tracks blockers for the release cadence.

decisions: Decision: JS SDK streaming will ship as 'beta' and be gated behind a feature flag due to a known serialization edge case with large nested schemas. Rationale: minimize launch risk for hosted customers while allowing early adopters to test. Owner: Mateo Chen

Decision: Structured output will use JSON Schema v2020-12 for canonical examples; we will defer adding Protobuf examples to next cycle to keep scope manageable. Rationale: JSON Schema covers the majority of use-cases and keeps docs accessible. Owner: Lara Singh

Decision: Function-calling will default to 'soft validation' at server side (warn + telemetry) for first two weeks, then switch to 'strict' for dedicated/private customers after compatibility signals. Rationale: avoid breaking existing integrations. Owner: Priya Patel
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: Edge cases in streaming backpressure could cause increased latency for multi-tenant pools. Mitigation: conservative canary (5% traffic), additional autoscale buffer, realtime SLO alerting
Risk: Sample apps reveal unexpected model output regressions for structured output parsing. Mitigation: add regression tests to CI with golden prompt sets and block release if F1 drops >5%
Risk: Documentation gaps cause high support tickets post-launch. Mitigation: ship a 'first 24h' triage rota with DevRel and Solutions Engineers and publish FAQ in docs
